conversations.answer: The error indicates that the promptFile variable has an inferred type of unknown when you're trying to assign to the attention property. TypeScript is raising this issue to ensure type safety.To fix this, you can either:Assert the type of promptFile if you're sure of its shape.Define an interface for the expected shape of promptFile.Let's proceed with the second option for better type safety.The shell script will:Define a new interface for PromptFile in a file named types.ts.Update readPromptFile.ts to specify the return type using the new PromptFile interface.Update writeAttention.ts to use the PromptFile interface.Let's write the shell script for that:[CODE_BLOCK_0]This should resolve the TypeScript error by providing a clear definition of what shape the promptFile is expected to have.
